scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @bookverse/shared build && pnpm run --parallel dev:web dev:api
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bookverse/shared build && pnpm --filter @bookverse/web build && pnpm --filter @bookverse/api build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bookverse/shared build && pnpm --filter @bookverse/web test && pnpm --filter @bookverse/api test
